title: tilia communis var. argentea
intro: Tilia communis var. argentea, commonly known as Silver Lime, is a rare and ornamental variety of the Tilia tree, known for its stunning silver-gray foliage. It has been used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including reducing anxiety and stress, promoting sleep, and alleviating symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of Silver Lime are attributed to its calming and anti-inflammatory properties, which work to soothe the mind and body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
